title: My Morning and Evening
text:
Hello, my name is Ali. I wake up at seven o'clock every morning. I brush my teeth and I eat breakfast. I like bread and tea. Then I go to school.

In the afternoon, I play football with my friends. In the evening, I do my homework. I go to bed at nine o'clock. I sleep well every night.

questions.text: What time does Ali wake up?
What does Ali do in the afternoon?
options: He plays football with his friends.

questions.text: What can we say about Ali's day?
options: He follows the same routine every day.
His day is different every day.
He does not go to school.

questions.text: What kind of person is Ali probably?
options: A person who likes a regular and healthy routine.
A person who does not like school.
A person who eats only at night.

paragraph_translations: Merhaba, benim adım Ali. Her sabah saat yedide uyanırım. Dişlerimi fırçalarım ve kahvaltı yaparım. Ekmek ve çay severim. Sonra okula giderim.
Öğleden sonra arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Akşamları ev ödevimi yaparım. Saat dokuzda yatağa giderim. Her gece iyi uyurum.
